races.paceDynamic: Punchbowl Flyer will lead from the start but faces immediate pressure from four prominent runners (Twilight Madness, Jojo Rabbit, Style King, Due Date) who all want prime positions just behind. This congestion will create a brisk early gallop as these horses jostle for position, with particular traffic dangers likely to develop 2-3 furlongs out when the field starts to fan across the track. The hold-up horses (White Umbrella, Travel Agent, Good Karma, Megaphone) will benefit from this setup as the early pace pressure will stretch the field and create gaps for late closers to exploit. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish fastest when others have done too much too early.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Profit
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quartet engage in early pace pressure as expected
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will drain the front-runners and create perfect conditions for the closers to sweep through. Travel Agent and White Umbrella are best positioned to capitalise with their proven finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Twilight Madness Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Twilight Madness can secure an uncontested prominent position without getting trapped
scenarios.body: His recent win and strong course form will prove decisive as he avoids the worst of the early scrimmaging. Style King could follow him through if positioned well.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Punchbowl Flyer Holds On
scenarios.trigger: If the pace pressure is less severe than expected and Punchbowl Flyer gets an easier lead
scenarios.body: His superior early speed gives him tactical control but his 9-year-old legs are vulnerable to sustained pressure. Luke Morris will need to judge the fractions perfectly.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Jojo Rabbit Fights Back
scenarios.trigger: If Jojo Rabbit can reproduce his recent Southwell victory form at this track
scenarios.body: His recent 5f win suggests he's found form but stepping back up to 6f after prominent racing could stretch his stamina. The weight rise is also a concern.

watchPoints.text: Watch for traffic problems developing 2-3 furlongs out as four prominent runners (Twilight Madness, Jojo Rabbit, Style King, Due Date) converge
Monitor Punchbowl Flyer's early fractions as any pressure from the prominent quartet could set up his collapse
Check if Travel Agent gets a clear run from the back as he has the form and style to capitalise on the expected pace scenario
Observe Jojo Rabbit's position turning for home as his recent 5f win may not translate to 6f stamina under pressure

The pace should be honest but not suicidal given only two genuine leaders over this 6f trip. This race shape favours hold-up horses who can finish strongly, as the early pace will soften up the leaders and prominent runners for late closers like Scheffler and Sargent Dennis.

scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Prevail

scenarios.trigger: If Cool Doc Boy or Goldenstateofmind get the perfect stalking position

scenarios.label: C

scenarios.trigger: If Afton Down gets an uncontested lead with Hamda's Joy settling
scenarios.body: The pace becomes too slow and allows the leader to dictate terms throughout, kicking clear when the pressure comes. Cieren Fallon's big-race experience proves crucial.

races.paceDynamic: Robusto will be the undisputed leader from the start, with Diamond Bay and Baileys Khelstar settling prominently behind him. The pace should be genuinely run but not excessive, as Robusto won't be pressured early with most of the field (Caramay, Crackergee, Solar Pass) adopting hold-up tactics. This creates a classic front-to-back scenario where the prominent runners get first run, but the hold-up horses will rely on Robusto's honest galloping to bring them into contention. The race shape clearly favours the prominent runners who can track the pace and kick first, as the hold-up brigade may struggle to make up ground if Robusto proves hard to peg back.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Robusto sets honest fractions and the prominent duo get first run
scenarios.body: Diamond Bay and Baileys Khelstar can utilise their tactical advantage to strike before the hold-up horses get organised. The steady pace allows them to conserve energy while staying close enough to pounce.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays
scenarios.trigger: If Robusto's class tells and he sustains his gallop to the line
scenarios.body: His RPR of 97 suggests he has the ability to make all, especially if the hold-up horses leave themselves too much to do. The 1m6f trip suits his stamina-laden style perfectly.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Revival
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves too strong and the leaders come back dramatically
scenarios.body: Solar Pass and Caramay can benefit from a truly-run race that sets up perfectly for their closing kicks. Both have shown good form on similar going and possess the class to capitalise.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the 130-day layoff hasn't dulled Crackergee's edge and the race falls apart
scenarios.body: His previous form suggests decent ability and the light weight could prove crucial if others underperform. Morrison rarely runs them without a chance despite the long absence.

This creates a sustainable tempo without significant early pressure, allowing the leader to dictate terms through the middle stages before the field converges in the final two furlongs. With multiple hold-up horses including Luansobe, Ahead Of Fashion, and Battle Standard positioned to deliver late challenges, the race shape strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can secure good early positions and kick clear when the pace lifts.

scenarios.title: Controlled Front Running
scenarios.trigger: If Mr Writer gets an easy lead and dictates fractions without early pressure

scenarios.body: Grow Old With Me or Law Court can sit perfectly placed behind a moderate tempo before striking in the final furlong when fresher than the leader. Their prominent style allows them to respond quickly when the race develops.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Late Closer Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the early tempo is genuinely slow and the field remains tightly bunched entering the final quarter-mile
scenarios.body: Luansobe or Ahead Of Fashion can unleash finishing kicks from their hold-up positions as the race becomes a sprint finish. The compressed field gives their style maximum opportunity to weave through and strike late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If Mr Writer goes too fast early or multiple horses challenge the leader aggressively
scenarios.body: The early pace becomes unsustainable, causing the front rank to weaken dramatically in the closing stages. This creates opportunities for any horse with reserve stamina regardless of typical running style.
